id: title:Gilbert09:instrument golden bake to diagnose hogpanion at snapshot

review.posthog_relevance: Adds diagnostic capability for hogpanion service state during golden image setup, aiding debugging of service availability or state consistency.
review.reason: Adds a diagnostic command to record hogpanion's state at snapshot time, including status and journal output, without failing the bake.
review.uncertainty: This is a maintenance and diagnostic improvement. The benefit is bounded to debugging support rather than a systemic capability or correctness fix. No broader systemic risk reduction or broader capability is demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunk IDs, P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1, both located in the products/tasks/backend/sandbox directory. P1.F1.H1 adds a diagnostic command to record hogpanion's state at snapshot time, while P1.F2.H1 modifies the smoke test to include additional status and journal output when hogpanion has no running MainPID.
